terra.problem: Saying the ruler would know exactly what was coming assumes his response to hearing the message.
The passage does not say that the nations were never asked.
“What he were” is ungrammatical and sounds unnatural.
The explanation repeats the answer without adding insight or sounding distinctively like Papa Dorin.
The lament does not say that no ruling of anything comes afterward.
The verse says he was made a spectacle before kings, not that they watched the casting as it happened.
“The whole neighborhood saw it” goes beyond the statement that the nations who know him are appalled.
“Nobody rushes in” asserts an absence the passage does not establish.
“This card” talks about the lesson rather than the passage.
The claim that lions and bears appear elsewhere in Scripture needs a reference.
Identifying Jacob as Israel’s forefather requires a reference outside this passage.
